name: User
definition: A registered account of the codebase_community site, identified by a numeric Id and labelled by a DisplayName.
scope: All user-level analysis: identity, demographics, reputation, badges, activity attribution.

name: Post
definition: Any content item published on the site. The single rows source for questions, answers and the wiki post kinds, discriminated by PostTypeId.
scope: Any analysis of published content, its ownership, score, views and lifecycle.

name: Question
definition: A post whose PostTypeId is 1. Questions are the only post kind that carries a Title and a Tags list.
scope: Question-level analysis: titles, tags, answers received.

name: Answer
definition: A post whose PostTypeId is 2, attached to the question it responds to through the ParentId column.
scope: Answer-level analysis and question/answer relationships.

name: Comment
definition: A short user remark attached to a post, recorded with its own author and creation timestamp.
scope: Comment activity, per-post comment trails, comment authorship.

name: Vote
definition: A single voting event cast by a user on a post, carrying a vote type and optionally a bounty amount.
scope: Voting behaviour, bounties, first-vote timing, vote receipts.

name: Badge Award
definition: A record that a named badge was granted to a user on a given date.
scope: Badge achievement analysis, earliest achievement timing, badge tallies.

name: Tag
definition: A topic label maintained in its own catalogue with a tag name and a post count.
scope: Topic-level analysis and tag catalogue lookups.

name: Post Revision
definition: A single recorded change to a post, carrying the revision kind, the acting user and the changed text.
scope: Editing history: who edited a post, when, and what field changed.

name: User Identifier
definition: The numeric key that identifies a user account and is reused wherever activity is attributed to a registered account.
scope: Joining activity tables to the user catalogue.

name: Display Name
definition: The human-readable name shown for a user. It is the label that analytical questions normally use to refer to a person, but it is not a key.
scope: Naming a user in a question and returning a user as an answer label.

name: User Age
definition: The self-declared age in years stored on a user account.
scope: Only defined for the subset of users who disclosed an age.

name: User Reputation
definition: The accumulated site reputation score of a user, used as the standard measure of standing in the community.
scope: Ranking or comparing users, and as a prominence threshold for their posts.

name: Post Title
definition: The headline text of a question. Matching a title is the usual way questions refer to a specific post.
scope: Available only for questions; answers and wiki posts have no title.

name: Post Tag List
definition: The topic labels attached to a question, stored as one delimited string on the post row rather than as separate rows.
scope: Topic membership of questions; membership tests must operate on the delimited list.

name: Post Type
definition: The discriminator that determines which kind of content a post row represents.
scope: Separating questions from answers and from the wiki/maintenance post kinds.

name: Vote Type
definition: The categorical kind of a voting event, distinguishing upvotes, downvotes, acceptance, favourites, bounties and moderation actions.
scope: Any analysis that needs a specific class of vote rather than votes in general.

name: Creation Date
definition: The timestamp at which a recorded event or entity came into existence.
scope: Time filtering, year extraction and earliest-event selection across posts, comments, votes and badges.

name: Post Score
definition: The net score of a post as maintained by the platform, reflecting the balance of positive and negative reactions.
scope: Measuring how well received a post is; also the field questions filter on with phrases such as 'score of over N'.

name: Post View Count
definition: The number of times a question has been viewed.
scope: Available only for questions.

name: Post Favorite Count
definition: The number of users who marked a question as a favourite, maintained as a counter on the post row.
scope: Question bookmarking interest. Sparse: only populated for questions that have been favourited.

name: Post Comment Count
definition: The number of comments attached to a post.
scope: Comment volume per post; populated for every post row.

name: Post Answer Count
definition: The number of answers a question has received.
scope: Populated only for questions.

name: Badge Count per User
definition: The number of badge awards a user has accumulated. Formulated in questions as 'number of users with more than N badges'.
scope: Per-user badge tallies.

name: Bounty Amount
definition: The reputation amount attached to a bounty vote, representing the reward a user offered on a post.
scope: Only defined on bounty-related votes; absent on all other vote rows.

name: Percentage of Posts
definition: A ratio expressing the share of posts satisfying a stated condition, computed as the conditional post count divided by a stated denominator post population and expressed on a 0-100 scale.
scope: Share-type questions. The denominator population must be the one the question names; the numerator is the same population restricted by the stated condition.

name: Elder User
definition: A user above senior age. The workload defines this as a user whose declared age exceeds 65.
scope: Demographic segmentation of post owners. Undefined for users with no declared age.

name: Closed Post
definition: A post that the community has closed. Closeness is recorded by the presence of a closed date; absence of that date means the post was not closed.
scope: Post lifecycle status, including questions about whether a post is finished.

name: Community Account
definition: The platform's background account, named Community, which takes ownership of community-wiki content on behalf of the site rather than acting as a person.
scope: Content attributed to Community must not be treated as authored by a human user; profile measures such as age are not meaningful for it.

name: Unregistered Author Label
definition: A display name recorded alongside an attribution slot that has no user identifier, used when the acting account is unavailable. The platform also synthesises names for accounts that never chose one.
scope: Distinguishing attributable registered authorship from label-only authorship.

name: Post Popularity
definition: How widely read a post is. The workload expresses popularity as the post's view count.
scope: Comparisons of posts or of their authors by readership.

name: User Influence
definition: How much standing a user has in the community. The workload expresses influence through reputation, so the most influential user is the user with the highest reputation.
scope: Selecting a single dominant user for ranking or comparison questions.

name: Earliest Event
definition: The chronologically first event of a kind performed by or awarded to an entity, obtained by selecting the minimum creation date over that entity's events.
scope: Phrases such as 'first vote', 'first badge', 'acquired the first'.
